posts.title: Navy, stone, olive: three colours that always work
posts.idea: Farbregel Navy · Stein · Oliv als nachmachbare Herbstkombination
posts.scene: Ruhige Mailänder Kopfsteinpflaster-Gasse, grauer Novembernachmittag; lehnt mit Schulter an ockerfarbener Steinwand, Ganzkörper leicht schräg, Hand in Hosentasche, olivgrüner Wollmantel über dem Unterarm; navy Merino-Rundhalspullover, steinbeige Bundfaltenhose aus Wolle, dunkelbraune Wildleder-Loafer; Blick in Kamera
posts.costDetail: 2x Nano Banana Pro 2K 4:5 (2 x 0,402 $); Vorrat war leer, zweite Variante als S001 in den Vorrat; TikTok-Zoomvideo per ffmpeg mit italian_night_house_01.mp3 (kostenlos)
posts.caption:
Navy, stone, olive. Three quiet colours that never fight each other, so you can get dressed in the dark in November.

Navy knit on top, stone wool trousers, and the olive coat for when the wind picks up. Brown suede shoes tie it together.

Which of the three would you wear first?

#italianstyle #menswear #autumnoutfit #milanstyle #colorcombination #aiinfluencer

posts.scene: Altstadtgasse an Steinmauer, weißes Hemd offen, braune Hosenträger, anthrazit Bundfaltenhose
posts.caption:
Suspenders do what a belt can't: the trousers hang from your shoulders, so the front pleats fall straight and the line from shirt to shoe stays clean. Pair them with high-rise trousers with buttons inside the waistband, never clip-ons, and leave the belt at home. Would you wear suspenders on a normal day?

#mensstyle #italianstyle #suspenders #classicmenswear #oldmoneystyle

posts.scene: Palazzo-Treppe abends, dunkelblauer Zweireiher, weißes Hemd offen, braune Loafer
posts.caption:
A navy double-breasted suit does the dressing for you. Keep the shirt white and open at the collar, skip the tie, and let brown loafers soften it for an evening walk instead of a meeting. Tie or no tie with a suit like this?

#mensstyle #italianstyle #doublebreasted #navysuit #classicmenswear

posts.scene: Eine cremefarbene Strick-Polo, drei Looks: Mailänder Gasse mit Navy-Bundfaltenhose + Wildleder-Loafern; Detail Espresso; Amalfi-Terrasse mit weißer Leinenhose + Sandalen; Hafen am Abend mit olivgrüner Overshirt-Jacke
posts.idea: Ein Teil, drei Abende: Knit-Polo tucked (Stadt), untucked (Küste), gelayert (Abend)
posts.caption:
One cream knit polo, three evenings. In Milan it goes tucked into navy pleated trousers with a brown belt and suede loafers. On the coast it comes out untucked over white linen, and when the air cools, an olive overshirt goes on top. The trick is the fabric: fine knit looks dressed up, but never stiff. Tucked or untucked, which one is you?

#mensstyle #italianstyle #knitpolo #classicmenswear #capsulewardrobe

posts.scene: Holzboot in türkiser Bucht, Leinenhemd offen, Leinenhose, Goldkette
posts.idea: Ton-in-Ton-Leinen: Hemd und Hose in derselben Sandfarbe
posts.caption:
Linen shirt and linen trousers in the same sand tone: one colour from collar to ankle makes the whole look calm and longer, and the creases are part of the charm. Keep the shirt open, add one thin chain, and go barefoot on deck. Matching linen set or mixed colours, what's your call?

#mensstyle #italianstyle #linen #summerstyle #amalficoast
